summary: King St cycleway west of Kent St: Ecocounter 239 (2012-2023, 4 channels per direction) is mostly clean apart from a 2014 Aug-Oct fault with night-time bursts on direction 328, a 14,414-bike Saturday in Feb 2017 and a run of single-slot spikes on direction 329 (mostly 2017-2018), all set missing. Metrocount 366 (Oct 2025 onward) is clean and moved from site 547 to site 568 on 2026-02-16 without a break, so each of its directions is one series across both sites. After a 2.7-year gap 366 reads about 44% above 239's last level, more than neighbouring growth, so the two counters are kept as separate series; 329 and 1770 are the citybound AM-peak flow and 328 and 1769 the outbound PM-peak flow.
